objective: Help the agency build a repeatable, informed small-commercial preparation practice through role-specific learning and a focused next action.

roles.goal: Choose a practical team development plan and learning priority.
Prepare a stronger BOP submission with the business story and risk details.
Recognize a business conversation and refer it to an authorized teammate.
Offer useful guidance when role or cohort is unknown; do not imply eligibility.

excludedUses: No quotes, prices, premium discounts, guaranteed savings, binding statements, eligibility decisions or invented product availability.
Do not expose account production figures in agent-facing copy.
Do not infer appointment or permissions from marketing cohort.
Do not create accounts, invite external users, send emails, publish a live campaign or add tracking destinations.
Do not use real customer, policy, claim or credential data.
